messages:
Anya (Support): Forwarding ticket #12345 from ACME — customer blocked on console: 403 when switching to project 'fraud-detector'. Nina is on a screenshare now. Account acme-42. Screenshot attached in the ticket.
Nina (Customer): Hi, I'm Nina from ACME. When I click Projects -> fraud-detector I get a 403 page. I was project owner earlier today. This started after an org cleanup. Request to /api/v1/projects/fraud-detector returned 403. Time: 2024-07-31T15:12Z. Please advise, we're blocked.
Ravi (SRE): Is that a UI-only 403 or do API calls return the same? Any console JS errors or network trace?
Anya (Support): Screenshot shows "403: You do not have permission to view this project." Customer also tried the API and got: `{\"status\":403,\"code\":\"permission_denied\"}` when hitting the project endpoint.
Liam (Platform): @Ravi did we push anything to role-sync or IAM mapping earlier today? I remember a deploy around 15:05.
deploy-bot (Console Bot): deploy-bot: role-sync-service v2.4.1 deployed to prod at 2024-07-31T15:04:30Z.
Ravi (SRE): thanks. Likely a role mapping regression — maybe SSO group names are being filtered. @Nina can you confirm you can still sign in and see the org? Also paste the failed request headers (redact Authorization).
Nina (Customer): I can sign in and see the org list, but the project list is empty and clicking the project link goes to 403. Here's the curl I ran:```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/fraud-detector
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "permission_denied",
  "details": "user lacks role 'project.viewer' for project 'fraud-detector'"
}
```
Anya (Support): Customer insists they were owner this morning. Ops runbook shows 'org-maintenance' job modified project memberships at ~15:03.
Liam (Platform): I can check mapping service logs. Short-term workaround is to add Nina explicitly as project-admin via admin UI, but that needs an org admin to approve. @Ravi can you rollback the role-sync deploy if we confirm it's the cause?
Ravi (SRE): I'd prefer a targeted patch; role-sync was accidentally excluding groups with "/legacy/" or other slashes in the name. Pushing a hotfix now. :wrench:
deploy-bot (Console Bot): role-sync-service: hotfix v2.4.2 deployed at 2024-07-31T15:22:10Z — applied group-name normalization. Audit log: remapped group 'acme-employees' -> 'org:employee'.
Nina (Customer): Confirmed — I can access the fraud-detector project again, no more 403. Thanks for the quick fix.
Anya (Support): Closing ticket #12345. Action items: add a guardrail in role-sync to warn on filtered group names, add KB with repro steps and rollback playbook. Suggested repro (for KB):```
# repro steps
1) Login to console as user with SSO account in group `acme-employees`.
2) Run: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/<project-slug>`
3) Observe 403 and response body: {"error":"permission_denied","details":"user lacks role 'project.viewer'"}
4) Check role-sync service logs for group-mapping entries between 15:00-15:10 UTC.
```
Thanks all, marking resolved.
